title: fusion.configure()
description: The object that fusion.configure() takes: one entry for each runtime that the application uses. Documented in docs/reference.md.

python.description: Python components: a folder of .py files with functions decorated with @action.

path.description: The directory with your components. ./python, if absent.

python.description: The command of the interpreter. It wins over venv.

venv.description: A virtual environment whose interpreter is used.

preload.description: Modules to import, running their @startup, before a worker is ready.

requirements.description: The file that the doctor checks. requirements.txt, if absent.

wasm.description: A WebAssembly module that runs in a sandbox. A runtime has one module: use one Fusion for each module.

cwd.description: Working directory of the worker. The folder of the module, if absent.

pool.description: The options that configure the pool of workers of a runtime: the same for every language.

workers.description: Processes in the pool. They start on demand.

concurrency.description: Calls that a worker runs at the same time. A WebAssembly module runs one at a time whatever this says.

timeout.description: Milliseconds per call (in a stream, the longest time without progress). 0 disables it.

maxQueue.description: Calls that wait for a worker before the error QUEUE_FULL.

startTimeout.description: Milliseconds that a worker has to become ready. Raise it for big models.

cancelGrace.description: Milliseconds that a worker has to cancel a call before it is killed.

maxCalls.description: Replace a worker after this many calls. Never, if absent.

maxMemory.description: Replace a worker that uses more memory than this: a number of bytes, or a text such as "512mb" or "1.5gb". No limit, if absent.

healthInterval.description: Ping the idle workers every this many milliseconds. 0 disables the health check.

healthTimeout.description: Milliseconds that a worker has to answer a ping.

forwardStderr.description: Show what the workers write to their error output.

env.description: The environment of the workers. The process environment, if absent. A WebAssembly module never sees it.

native.description: A worker that is a binary that you built (Rust or Go).

binary.description: The path of the worker you built.

cwd.description: Working directory of the worker. The folder of the binary, if absent.

shadowCopy.description: Run the worker from a copy, so that the build can replace the file while it runs. True on Windows by default.

callOptions.description: The options of a single call: fusion.python(fn, args, options), fusion.call(runtime, fn, args, options) and fusion.stream(...). A signal (an AbortSignal) can also be given; it is not JSON.

timeout.description: Milliseconds for this call. In a stream, the longest time without progress. 0 disables it.

idempotent.description: The call can be repeated on another worker if its worker dies.

retries.description: How many times a call that is idempotent is repeated.

highWaterMark.description: In a stream, how many chunks the worker may run ahead of the consumer.
